landingTagline2.message: ଆଉ ଭୁଲ ସୂଚନା ନାହିଁ। କେବଳ ତଥ୍ୟ।

disclaimerJurisdiction.message: ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଭିତରେ, କେବଳ ଆଲାବାମା, ଆରିଜୋନା, କାଲିଫର୍ନିଆ, କଲୋରାଡୋ, କନେକ୍ଟିକଟ୍, ଡେଲାୱେୟାର୍, ଫ୍ଲୋରିଡା, ଆଇଡାହୋ, ଇଲିନଏ, ଇଣ୍ଡିଆନା, ଆଇଓୱା, କାନ୍ସାସ୍, କେଣ୍ଟକି, ଲୁଇଜିଆନା, ମେନ୍, ମାସାଚୁସେଟ୍ସ, ମିସିସିପି, ମିସୌରି, ମଣ୍ଟାନା, ନ୍ୟୁ ହ୍ୟାମ୍ପସାୟାର୍, ନ୍ୟୁ ମେକ୍ସିକୋ, ନ୍ୟୁୟର୍କ, ଉତ୍ତର କାରୋଲିନା, ଉତ୍ତର ଡାକୋଟା, ଓକ୍ଲାହୋମା, ଓରେଗନ୍, ପେନସିଲଭାନିଆ, ଦକ୍ଷିଣ କାରୋଲିନା, ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଡାକୋଟା, ଟେନେସି, ଟେକ୍ସାସ୍, ୟୁଟା, ୱାଶିଂଟନ୍, ୱିସ୍କନ୍ସିନ୍, ଏବଂ ୱାୟୋମିଂର ବାସିନ୍ଦାମାନେ DisinfaX ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବେ ଏବଂ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସ ଟପ୍ ଅପ୍ କରିପାରିବେ; ୱାଶିଂଟନ୍, D.C., ସମସ୍ତ ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଅଞ୍ଚଳ, ଏବଂ ତାଲିକାଭୁକ୍ତ ନ ଥିବା କୌଣସି ରାଜ୍ୟ ବାଦ ପଡ଼ିଛି। ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ବାହାରେ, ଏହା କାନାଡା, ଅଷ୍ଟ୍ରେଲିଆ, ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲାଣ୍ଡ, ସିଙ୍ଗାପୁର, ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକା, ଜାପାନ, ତାଇୱାନ, ଇଣ୍ଡୋନେସିଆ, ଥାଇଲାଣ୍ଡ, ଫିଲିପାଇନ୍ସ, ମାଲେସିଆ, ଭିଏତନାମ, ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱିଜରଲାଣ୍ଡରେ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ।

appDescription.message: AI ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ପୋଷ୍ଟରେ ଭୁଲ ସୂଚନା ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରେ ଏବଂ ହାଇଲାଇଟ୍ କରେ।

verdictTrue.description: Standalone verdict label: the claim is true.

verdictFalse.description: Standalone verdict label: the claim is false.

verdictUnknown.description: Verdict label when the claim cannot be determined.

verdictResearching.description: Verdict label shown while the claim is being analyzed.

researchingWords.description: Pipe-separated list of playful words shown at random (one per claim) on the claim-highlight badge while that claim is being fact-checked, instead of a static 'Fact-Checking' label.

adjMostly.description: Veracity adjective: mostly true/false with some nuance.

adjArguably.description: Veracity adjective: arguably true/false, leaning one way.

adjPartially.description: Veracity adjective: partially true/false, mixed evidence.

adjEquivocally.description: Veracity adjective: equivocally true/false, balanced evidence.

badgeVerdictOnly.description: Badge pattern with only the verdict word.

badgeVerdictAdj.description: Badge pattern: verdict + adj in parens.

badgeAdjVerdictAdj2.description: Badge: confidence adj, filler, veracity adj, verdict. $ADJ2$$, filler, $ADJ$$, $VERDICT$$.

refreshBatchTooltip.message: ଏହି ପୋଷ୍ଟର ସମସ୍ତ ଦାବିକୁ ପୁଣି ପ୍ରକାଶ କରନ୍ତୁ
refreshBatchTooltip.description: Tooltip for the button that re-runs preclassification (finds and highlights this tweet's claims) without researching them.

refreshClaimTooltip.description: Tooltip for the individual claim re-research button.

researchingText.description: Text shown next to the spinner while waiting for analysis results.

annotateButton.description: Button in the claim popover that runs a second AI pass to mark suspected errors in the claim text with strikethrough and show corrections.

annotatingText.description: Text shown on the Annotate button while the annotation pass is running.

translateFactChecks.description: Button shown at top of tweet when fact-check highlights need translation to the browser language.

translateClaimButton.description: Button in popover to translate a specific claim text or reasoning to the browser language.

badgeFiller.description: Filler word between confidence adjective and veracity adjective in the combined badge pattern.

badgeAdjVerdictAdj2Verbose.description: Badge: verbose confidence adj, filler, veracity adj, verdict for multi-word adjectives.

factCheckedFloatingButton.description: Floating button shown at the top of the timeline when an on-hold tweet finishes classification off-screen. Clicking scrolls back to the tweet.

goBackFloatingButton.description: Floating button shown at the bottom of the timeline after scrolling back to a classified tweet. Clicking returns the user to their original scroll position.

revealButton.description: Button that shows the tweet's cached fact-check highlights (hidden by default until the user asks to see them).

hideButton.description: Button that hides the tweet's fact-check highlights again after they were revealed.

disinfactButton.description: Button that identifies the claims in a tweet and looks up their verdicts in the database.

disinfacting.description: Label shown over a text selection while its analysis is starting ("Disinfacting" + spinner).

localizeButton.description: Button shown at top of tweet when fact-check highlights were made for another language version and need to be repositioned for the current text.

checkoutError.message: ଚେକଆଉଟ୍ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରାଯାଇପାରିଲା ନାହିଁ। ଦୟାକରି ପୁନର୍ବାର ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

disclaimerAgree.message: ଟପ୍ ଅପ୍ କରି, ଆପଣ ଆମର %TOS% ଏବଂ %PRIVACY% ସହ ସହମତ ହୁଅନ୍ତି।

disclaimerFx.message: ଯଦି ଆପଣ USD ବ୍ୟତୀତ ଅନ୍ୟ ମୁଦ୍ରାରେ ଦେୟ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରନ୍ତି ତେବେ ବୈଦେଶିକ ମୁଦ୍ରା ବିନିମୟ ଶୁଳ୍କ ଲାଗୁ ହୋଇପାରେ।

deleteAccount.message: ଖାତା ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ତଥ୍ୟ ବିଲୋପ କରନ୍ତୁ
deleteAccount.description: Destructive button at the bottom of the popup settings that permanently deletes the user's account, its funds and its subscriptions, and cements the retention of an identity hash and the balance (see the note directly beneath it).

deleteAccountNote.message: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସ, ଏବଂ ଏକ ଗୁପ୍ତ କି ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଇମେଲ୍ ଠିକଣାର ଏକ କ୍ରିପ୍ଟୋଗ୍ରାଫିକ୍ ହ୍ୟାସ୍, ଖାତା ଖୋଲିବା ସମୟରେ ଦିଆଯାଉଥିବା ମାଗଣା ଅର୍ଥର ଅପବ୍ୟବହାର ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ ରଖାଯାଏ। ସେହି ଖାତାରେ ପୁଣି ସାଇନ୍ ଅପ୍ କଲେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସ ଫେରିଆସେ।
deleteAccountNote.description: Small print under the Delete Account button stating exactly what is retained after deletion and that the balance comes back on the next sign-in. Not a warning to be brief with: it is the only place the user is told the hash is kept.

onboardDisinfactClick.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଦାବିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିବ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

onboardDisinfactTap.message: %BTN% ଟାପ୍ କରିବା ଦାବିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିବ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

onboardLocalize.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ହାଇଲାଇଟ୍ ଗୁଡିକ ସ୍ଥାନିତ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ତୁମର ବାଲାନ୍ସ ଚାର୍ଜ ହେବ |

onboardAnnotate.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ତ୍ରୁଟି ପାଇଁ ଦାବି ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରେ ଏବଂ ତୁମର ବାଲାନ୍ସ ଚାର୍ଜ କରିବ |

onboardWillCharge.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

onboardFactcheck.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

onboardTranslations.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

onboardRefreshes.message: %BTN% କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରିବା ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯିବ

aiDisclaimer.message: DisinfaX ଭୁଲ କରିପାରେ। ସୂଚନା ପୁନର୍ବାର ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରନ୍ତୁ।
aiDisclaimer.description: AI-accuracy disclaimer shown in very small text at the bottom of every claim popover (below the sources) and under the version number in the popup.

errBalanceTooLow.message: ତୁମର ବାଲାନ୍ସ ବହୁତ କମ୍। ଜାରି ରହିବାକୁ ଦୟାକରି ଟପ୍ ଅପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ।

balanceEmpty.message: ତୁମର ବାଲାନ୍ସ ଶେଷ ହୋଇଯାଇଛି। ଦୟାକରି DisinfaX ପପ୍‌ଅପ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ତୁମ ବାଲାନ୍ସରେ ଟଙ୍କା ଯୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।
balanceEmpty.description: Shown when the user's balance + hold is empty (zero or negative): on opening X.com with empty funds, and when funds cross from positive to empty.

errNotSignedIn.message: ତୁମେ ସାଇନ୍ ଇନ୍ ହୋଇନାହଁ। ଦୟାକରି ସାଇନ୍ ଇନ୍ କରି ପୁନଃ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

errInvalidRequest.message: ଏହି ଅନୁରୋଧର କିଛି ଅଂଶ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହୋଇନାହିଁ। ଏକ୍ସଟେନ୍ସନ ଅପଡେଟ ଥିବା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରନ୍ତୁ।

errServiceUnavailable.message: ଆମ ପକ୍ଷରୁ ଏକ ତ୍ରୁଟି ହୋଇଛି। ଦୟାକରି କିଛି ସମୟ ପରେ ପୁନଃ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

errRegionNotSupported.message: ନିୟାମକ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ହେତୁ DisinfaX ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଏପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନାହିଁ।

errInvalidAmount.message: ସେହି ଟପ୍-ଅପ୍ ପରିମାଣ ବୈଧ ନାହିଁ। ଦୟାକରି ଏକ ଭିନ୍ନ ପରିମାଣ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

errNotFound.message: ତାହା ମିଳିଲା ନାହିଁ। ପୁନଃ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ।

errNoClaims.message: ଏହି ପାଠ୍ୟରେ କୌଣସି ଯାଞ୍ଚଯୋଗ୍ୟ ଦାବି ମିଳିଲା ନାହିଁ।
errNoClaims.description: Red in-page notification shown after a fact-check run found no claims at all in the text, so there was nothing to research.

settings.description: Header of the collapsible settings section at the bottom of the popup.

appearanceLabel.description: Label of the popup's appearance setting, which switches the popup and the on-page fact-check windows between a light and a dark palette.

themeLight.description: Appearance choice that always uses the light palette.

themeAuto.description: Appearance choice that follows the browser's or device's own light/dark setting.

themeDark.description: Appearance choice that always uses the dark palette.

bypassToggleLabel.description: Label of the master toggle: bypassed claims keep their fact-checks visible while hidden. Ends with a colon; the toggle sits beside it.

bypassVeracityLabel.description: Label of the maximum-veracity slider. $1 is the signed percentage (e.g. -75%); the live adjective + verdict readout follows after this label.

bypassConfidenceLabel.description: Label of the minimum-confidence slider. $1 is the percentage (e.g. 20%); the live adjective + verdict readout follows after this label.

factCheckTab.description: Label of the Fact-Check tab in the popup.

enterClaimPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the Fact-Check tab text field.

sourcesLabel.description: Header for the sources list in fact-check results.

reasoningLabel.description: Header for reasoning text in fact-check results.

selectionConfirmWarning.message: ଟେକ୍ସଟ୍ ଚୟନ କରି ପପ୍ଅପ୍ ଖୋଲିଲେ ସେହି ଚୟନ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ହେବ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ କଟାଯିବ।
selectionConfirmWarning.description: Shown once, before the first selection fact-check, to disclose that the run costs money.

selectionConfirmCancel.description: Declines the selection fact-check in the first-open confirmation.

clearButton.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button beside the Fact-Check text field that empties the tab.

enableOnInstance.description: Offer, in the popup, to turn DisinfaX on for the Mastodon instance in the active tab. $HOST$ is the instance domain, e.g. mastodon.social.

instanceEnabled.description: Shown in the popup once the Mastodon instance in the active tab has been enabled. $HOST$ is the instance domain.

turnOff.description: Button in the popup that turns DisinfaX off for the Mastodon instance it is currently enabled on.

persistentBadgesLabel.description: Label of the Colourblind-friendly setting in the extension's settings, which keeps fact-check badges on posts instead of showing them only under the pointer.

persistentBadgesTooltip.message: ପୋଷ୍ଟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଉପରେ କର୍ସର ନ ରଖି ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସତ୍ୟ ଯାଞ୍ଚ ବ୍ୟାଜ୍ ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଏକ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଶବ୍ଦ ସହିତ ହାଇଲାଇଟ୍ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଇଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏହା ସେହି ରଙ୍ଗଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଚିହ୍ନି ନ ପାରୁଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
persistentBadgesTooltip.description: Description under the Colourblind-friendly setting, and its tooltip, explaining why a reader might want badges always visible.

largeFontLabel.description: Label of the Large font size setting in the extension's settings, which enlarges the rewritten claims, the reasoning, and the onboarding hints shown over posts and pages.

largeFontTooltip.description: Description under the Large font size setting, and its tooltip, explaining what it enlarges.

closeTooltip.description: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the X control that closes a fact-check popover.

editClaimTooltip.message: ଦାବି ସମ୍ପାଦନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ
editClaimTooltip.description: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the fact-check text field when it is not being edited; clicking it starts editing.

claimPopoverLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the fact-check detail popover that opens over a claim.

errSelectionTooLong.message: ଏହି ଚୟନ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ଅତି ଲମ୍ବା। ସର୍ବାଧିକ 1,000 ଅକ୍ଷର।
errSelectionTooLong.description: Red in-page notification shown when the user starts a fact-check on a selection longer than 1,000 characters. The run is refused before it starts, so nothing is charged.

notifySpendLabel.description: Label of the toggle that turns on notifications for when the balance decreases.

notifySpendThresholdLabel.description: Label of the slider that sets the smallest balance decrease that still notifies. $1 is the formatted US dollar amount (e.g. US$0.001 or 0,001 US$); the slider sits beside this label.

guideHowToFactCheck.description: Title of the panel that tells a signed-in user how to fact-check a page selection.

guideSelectText.message: ଯେକୌଣସି ୱେବପେଜ୍‌ରେ, ଆପଣ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ପାଠ୍ୟ ଚୟନ କରନ୍ତୁ।

guideRightClick.message: ଚୟନିତ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଉପରେ ରାଇଟ୍-କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରି ଯାଞ୍ଚ ଚୟନ କରନ୍ତୁ (ଅଣଚୟନିତ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଉପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ)।
guideRightClick.description: Step 2 of the how-to-fact-check panel, on Safari. Names the menu entry by itself.

guideRightClickLogo.message: ଚୟନିତ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଉପରେ ରାଇଟ୍-କ୍ଲିକ୍ କରି {1} ଯାଞ୍ଚ ଚୟନ କରନ୍ତୁ (ଅଣଚୟନିତ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଉପରେ ମଧ୍ୟ କାମ କରେ)।
guideRightClickLogo.description: Step 2 of the how-to-fact-check panel, on Chromium and Firefox. {1} is the app mark drawn before the menu entry’s name.

guideCharged.message: ଯାଞ୍ଚ ତୁରନ୍ତ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ ଏବଂ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାଲାନ୍ସରୁ ଚାର୍ଜ କରାଯାଏ।

guideTapSelectedPrefix.description: First half of step 2 on iPhone and iPad, ending just before the extensions button’s icon.

guideTapSelectedSuffix.message: ଠିକଣା ବାର୍‌ରେ ଥିବା ଆଇକନ୍ ଉପରେ ଟାପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ, ତାପରେ {1} DisinfaX ଚୟନ କରନ୍ତୁ।
guideTapSelectedSuffix.description: Second half of step 2 on iPhone and iPad, starting just after the extensions button’s icon. {1} is the app mark.

copiedLabel.description: Spoken by a copy button once the text is on the clipboard.

balanceNotAvailable.description: Stands in for a balance that has not been reported yet.
